_about: Single source of truth for date-filtered fixture blocks rendered into static HTML by scripts/build-fixtures.mjs. Keys are list ids; each row carries an ISO `date` (same pattern as the homepage ticker, e.g. "2026-08-29") used to drop past fixtures and sort ascending, plus the display fields that list's markup needs. `date: null` means always render (undated, like the ticker). Do NOT swap/replace/add images here — image paths are transcribed verbatim from the committed pages (image-lock rule). Rebuild with: node scripts/build-fixtures.mjs
